intro: Rwanda has about 14 million people and is one of Africa's most densely populated countries.

chapters.title: People
text: Kinyarwanda is spoken by everyone; English, French and Swahili are also official. The government discourages ethnic labels and stresses a shared Rwandan identity. Most people are Christian.

chapters.title: Kigali
text: Kigali is known as one of Africa's cleanest cities; plastic bags have been banned since 2008.
